question: 当请求序列数 N_req 超过 N_max 时，vLLM 的实际吞吐量下降比例并非简单的线性 (1 - N_max/N_req)，而是受限于显存带宽竞争导致的单序列解码速度降低；在 N_req=8, N_max=4 的场景下，由于 L2 Cache 命中率下降和 HBM 带宽饱和，实测吞吐量下降比例通常高达 60%-70%。

sources.title: Performance and Tuning — vLLM
sources.snippet: If max_num_batched_tokens is the same as max_model_len, that's almost the equivalent to the default scheduling policy (except that it still prioritizes decodes). Note that the default value (512) of max_num_batched_tokens is optimized for ITL, and it may have lower throughput than the default scheduler.
